extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.24[CR]- Show a show's season cards first; selecting a season opens its episodes.[CR]- Preserve season/episode Back navigation even when both share Amazon's detail URL.[CR]- Display Sign out at the far right and sign out directly when selected.[CR]- Load content sections automatically as the top navigation gains focus.[CR]- Open a genre drawer with Down on Movies or TV, using 12 verified Amazon category links and live navigation refresh.[CR]- Follow actual genre collection links; preserve Prime-only/type filtering and first-two-page preloading.[CR]- Match the entire focused word with native font glow, including the first and last letters.[CR]- Remove invisible/private-use/invalid display characters and decode HTML entities in descriptions.[CR]- Record season/genre/focus/text-glyph diagnostics; preserve authentication, media resolution and playback bytes.
